before.description: Terrence Clyne, 68, of Orland Park IL, was charged with misdemeanor battery and felony hate crime for punching his Palestinian neighbor while shouting hateful remarks; dispute stemmed from trash can placement in shared driveway. Pleaded guilty to misdemeanor battery; felony hate crime dropped. Probation.
